caption: The drawing depicts a small figurine placed on what appears to be a rectangular book or base with tan and brown coloration and signs of wear along the edges. Seated on the base is a human figure wearing a light purple or gray top, blue trousers, brown shoes, and a green hat. The figure has one arm raised, as if waving. Next to the human figure is an animal resembling a sheep or a llama, which is positioned on a green patch on the base toward the left side. The animal is white with visible facial features and stands calmly beside the seated figure. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the drawing is centered on the page, with the artist's name “HARRY GRASIER” written in small letters below the object, slightly to the right.
title: Toy Boy and Goat
